_comment: Curated JOIN overrides for the HuggingFace harvest (cmd/bestiary-hf). A key is a case-preserved Hub org/repo path; its value is the precise entity tuple the repo names, used where the mechanical decomposition would land on the WRONG (usually coarser) entity — e.g. 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2' decomposes to the coarse 'deepseek' bucket while the repo names the 'deepseek/v3.2' entity every other provider serves. Curated > mechanical (the parse/ curated-overrides precedent). A repo listed here is ALWAYS included in a live run's fetch list (a curator explicitly wants it verified), regardless of the request cap. The four entries below mirror the curated huggingface claims in nomen_claims.json EXACTLY (same resolves_to tuple), so a harvested attestation for each coalesces onto the curated claim's (Value, huggingface-scheme, ResolvesTo) triple — the same-triple multi-attestation union (validation case 3). Case must match the curated claim's repo path or the triples will not collide.
